description: This file contains a partial class implementation of RedisReminderTable which manages reminder entries stored in Redis for the Orleans framework. It includes methods for initialization, reading, writing, removing, and clearing reminder data, utilizing Redis sorted sets and scripts for atomic operations.

classes.name: RedisReminderTable
classes.description: A class responsible for managing Redis-based reminder storage, with methods to initialize, read, write, delete, and clear reminders, using Redis sorted sets and scripting for atomic updates.

methods.name: RedisReminderTable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the table with configuration options and a logger.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets key expiry if configured.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a given grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads all reminders for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminders within a specified range defined by begin and end.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder for a grain ID and reminder name, if matching eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table, meant for testing.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry atomically using a Redis script.

methods.name: ConvertToEntry
methods.description: Converts a Redis string value to a ReminderEntry object.

methods.name: GetFilter
methods.description: Generates key range boundaries for querying Redis based on various identifier segments.

methods.name: ConvertFromEntry
methods.description: Serializes a ReminderEntry to a Redis-compatible string and generates a new eTag.
